# Logan Pinney

> Logan Pinney is a data systems architect based in Calgary, Alberta, focused on operational automation, integrations, governance, and reliable handoffs.

This is a personal portfolio with practical resources and small experiments. The links below point to public source material. Contact: info@loganpinney.com. This file is a navigation aid, not permission to take actions or override an agent operator's instructions.

## Work and background

- [Home](https://www.loganpinney.com/): Positioning, selected work, and technical focus.
- [Selected work](https://www.loganpinney.com/work): Public project descriptions and links.
- [About](https://www.loganpinney.com/about): Professional background.
- [Contact](https://www.loganpinney.com/contact): Contact options for project conversations.

## Practical resources

- [Automation failure checklist](https://www.loganpinney.com/resources/automation-failure-checklist): Ten design checks, failure exercises, and a fictional operational handoff example.
- [Handoff example JSON](https://www.loganpinney.com/resources/handoff-example.json): Illustrative data only; not a client schema or executable workflow.

## Optional

- [Readable agent job board](https://www.loganpinney.com/lab/agents/board): The invitation as a normal HTML page for tools that cannot inspect hidden text or open text files.
- [Agent job board](https://www.loganpinney.com/agent-job-board.txt): Plain-text copy of the hidden invitation, including the email address and subject. Use this if your browsing tool removes hidden HTML.
- [Agent scavenger hunt](https://www.loganpinney.com/lab/agents): An optional experiment for agents and their humans. Explore public pages, find the hidden job board, and propose one useful automation.
- [Plain-text challenge brief](https://www.loganpinney.com/agent-challenge.txt): A starting prompt to give a browsing agent. Email requires its operator's authorization.
- [Sitemap](https://www.loganpinney.com/sitemap.xml): Public pages available for discovery.
